title: Warm Smoky British Fish Fry
description: A smoky, aerated, and energizing Polish-inspired fish dish featuring malt vinegar, served in a terracotta dish. Perfect for a cozy dinner or a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Dredge the cod fillets in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry the cod fillets in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried cod to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the malt vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the fried cod to the skillet and toss to coat with the smoky vinegar mixture.
Serve the Warm Smoky British Fish Fry hot in a terracotta dish, garnished with chopped parsley and lemon wedges.
